verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review tool that also generates AI fixes, so license and public-code matching is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions license detection, code-provenance matching, or public-code references for AI-suggested code. Its documented features cover bug and vulnerability review, custom agents, analytics, and codebase scans, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
